relevance_note: Single case report of a NOD2 variant carrier with Blau syndrome: "A heterozygous c.1000C>T transition in exon 4, p. R334W, of the NOD2 gene was identified in the patient".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON. Rows: the case-report patient; her two parents (sex not stated, labelled 'parent of patient' and 'parent of patient 2'), in scope as relatives tested negative for the variant and described as healthy with no uveitis or arthritis; they get no variant rows because they do not carry it. Three previously published people from the Discussion are included because each has an individual-level fact (variant and a feature): the PRC patient with p.R334W who developed uveitis and glaucoma (the sentence has no citation of its own; the paragraph's only citation is [7], so the label is 'ref [7] patient' and source '[7]', which is uncertain - the preceding sentence cites [78]); and the two patients of ref [9] paired by 'respectively' (p.R334W with 'large vessels', p.G464W with Takayasu's arteritis). The feature 'presence of large vessels' is as printed and ambiguous, so the vasculitis checklist item for 'ref [9] patient' is left not reported. Gene symbol for the literature patients is not printed in their sentences; NOD2 follows from the paper's context (spans given). Patient exclusions in the Discussion ('did not show any of the above-mentioned symptoms') cover recurrent fever, generalized lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, hepatomegaly, hepatitis, large vessels and Takayasu's arteritis; under the narrow/broad rule recurrent fever does not exclude 'fever', hepatomegaly does not exclude 'hepatomegaly or hepatic granulomas', and Takayasu's arteritis does not exclude the composite vasculitis item. Variant type 'missense' rests on the stated 'arginine to tryptophan substitution'. Age 18 months is the age at presentation, not stated as last evaluation, so age at last evaluation is not reported; vital status not stated explicitly. No contradictions found.
